_readme: Appendix (ب) of the Terms requires this matrix to exist BEFORE the service is sold commercially,
and forbids adopting any percentage, amount or 'non-refundable' label that has not been matched
against the actual supplier contracts: « ويجب ألا تعتمد أي نسبة أو مبلغ أو وصف (غير قابل
للاسترداد) إلا بعد مطابقته مع العقود الفعلية مع الموردين وطبيعة الخدمة والقواعد القانونية الآمرة ».
So this file ships with the STRUCTURE filled and the commercial numbers deliberately empty.
A component with no matching rule is reported as 'undetermined' — never as zero refund and never
as a full refund. That is the point: the software refuses to invent a figure, and the back office
is handed the exact list of what is still missing.
Set status to 'active' and verifiedAgainstSupplierContracts to true only once every rule below
carries a basis taken from a real contract. RefundCalculator refuses to quote a customer-facing

components.label: الباقة
_note: The 'pack' price line bundles several of the components article 72 requires to be settled
SEPARATELY (ticket, hotel, agency service). Until the agency declares how that single price
divides, this component cannot be settled per component and the calculator reports it as
undetermined. Fill 'split' below with the real share of each component.

_splitExample._comment: Shape expected in components[].split once the real shares are known.

rules._source: Article 72 — « ويخصم فقط ما يجوز خصمه … بما في ذلك قيمة الخدمات التي تم تنفيذها ».

deduction.basis: المادة (72): تُخصم قيمة الخدمات التي تم تنفيذها فعلياً.

rules._source: Article 77 — the company cancels for a reason of its own and offers no alternative.
_note: The visa is deliberately NOT in this rule. Article 77 gives the customer back what is due
for the cancelled service, while article 73 says the visa amount follows the stage reached
and what the authority actually kept. Once the application is in, those two pull in
different directions, and resolving that is a lawyer's call, not a default. So
visa/submitted and visa/issued under 'company_cancelled' stay open cells on purpose.

deduction.basis: المادة (77): يحق للعميل استرداد المبلغ المستحق عن الخدمة الملغاة.

rules._source: Article 73 — government fees follow the competent authority's own refund rules.

deduction.basis: المادة (73): يُحدَّد المبلغ وفق المرحلة التي وصل إليها الطلب والرسوم المدفوعة والخدمة التي نُفِّذت فعلياً.

rules._source: Article 73 — nothing is due yet while the application has not been submitted.

deduction.basis: المادة (73): لم يبدأ الإجراء ولم تُدفع رسوم حكومية بعد.

_rulesToFill: Everything below is a COMMERCIAL term that only the supplier contracts can settle. Each entry
must become a rule above, with a basis quoting the contract clause it comes from.
ticket / issued / client          — carrier penalty by fare class (article 74)
ticket / issued / visa_refused    — carrier rules when the visa is refused (articles 28, 74)
hotel  / confirmed / client       — hotel cancellation window and penalty (article 74)
hotel  / confirmed / no_show      — hotel no-show charge (articles 60, 74)
transport / confirmed / client    — bus operator terms (article 74)
package                           — the 'split' above, then the rules of each share
supplier_cancelled / supplier_default / force_majeure for every component (articles 78, 79, 80)
Time tiers: article 71 makes the TIME THE REQUEST IS RECEIVED decisive. Add 'daysBeforeDeparture'
to a rule ({ "from": 15, "to": 30 }) to make it apply only inside that window.

forbidden._source: Article 72 — « ولا يجوز اعتبار كامل المبلغ غير قابل للاسترداد لمجرد ورود وصف عام بذلك ».
